text.body:
yohiprāpti śikṣā
śrīmadgaṇeśaṃ praṇipatya devānśrīsūryanārāyaṇasuprasādāt vakṣye kriyāyā svaralakṣaṇaṃ tadyaddhomakanyāpurasūribhaṭṭaḥ 1
tasmāccatvāriparaścedaharaccādyudāttavān prāyacchattriryavaṃ tasmāttasmai tveṣa parastvasi 2
prāviśattaṃ prāha tādṛgyatsomaḥ prājanayattathā prāveśayantyādadata tatprāyuñjata tena ca 3
mindābhūnmāyāsītkuṃbhyādādasti syavapūrvakaḥ bha āśayāddhi pūrvaśca paribhūrasi sādigam 4
jahīndraśśṛṇute māntaścinute'pātmaśīrṣa ca prokṣitaṃ vīkṣitāyātra ādiśabdāvudāttagau 5
cinute tho sarvaṃ nīcaṃ yacchabdātpara ityapi sāṃhitena svareṇāpi jñeyaśśeṣasvaro budhaiḥ 6
yadyāvacchabdakau yatra yathādyucco yato yadi yadā yarhi hyadhaścādirādvādaśātkriyocca bhāk 7
yā prajāḥ parābahurvai yo vai de prāṇa uttaraḥ ya evamaharyatsomaḥ prayattriḥ prāyayaddhiman 8
yanmaitrāvaruṇa yo vaisau yathākṣaṃśca yo'gniṣaḥ hyeta vidviryathānasi tribhavedyatpunaścitim 9
āyurvā anyaśabdādissomaṃ vāruṇa eṣa te pṛthivyai tveti some'pi na kuryātpūrvayāpi ca 10
vatsañcādhiśrayatyantaṃ nāvave prapurodaye apayuṣmadādyāvartatāntamavarṇa āditaḥ 11
nakṣodhukaśca sā somamaddhvānogniḥ purā sabhām agniramuṣmindevānāṃ trīṇi ca śakathā gavi 12
somo'gnirevāsmā ūrdhvassatyādanasthikena ca ādityā amuṣmiṃścācyutpayo viśve'nvatiṣṭhattat 13
vānyaśabdau pūrvapakṣe pūrveṣvā pañcamastathā savyo na yajñaṃ vasvī ca dvirninā nāyatānṛṇam 14
yavaṃ saudāsānabhordhvo rathacakraparāsu ca saṃbandhaścāntasānnidhye tulyayorādiruccavān 15
mayati vaṣaṭ stṛṇute tṛtīṣorundha eva ca yunakti prajāpāsyastu pāhyādi yajurādi cet 16
na ghnīṇyṛṣabhaṃ dvedvedhaḥ kriyā cānyaśrutīṃgyabhāk yathā manurmanuṣyāśca yodayājīsayo yathā 17
śīrṣṇādidhruva ūṣāścānvañcāvājyaṃ purīṣa ca aṅgāreṣvāruṇo veṇorajā vediḥ paraṃ ca yat 18
upahyātmano devānāṃ suvargo'śvācca cakṣuṣī rudro mṛnmayamūrdhvo hi nīcaṃ dadhāti kevalam 19
cityāmanyāṃ ca nānyāṃ ca purastādanyā yadītaram ghāryārabhyāpitanmadhye tacchabde'nīcake sthite 20
saṃkhyā śabde'pyanedante sānnidhyaṃ naikamaṣṭakam apūrve'pi kriyā nityamityādyanyayajuḥsthitam 21
na hi sa taṃ hi te tāṃ hi tasya māyā hi tattathā yānte gacchantu yastasyāṃ yattadyeṣāṃ hi cātra hi 22
yo yakṣye yasyaivaṃ yattaṃ yāvāneva ya ityapi tatsvarasūcanārthaṃ hi bālānāmiti varṇitaḥ 23
iti yohiprāptimūlaṃ samāptam
